author: The Mandated Reporter
description: Daily Bread is the podcast where biblical truth is served fresh, simple, and easy to understand. Join The Mandated Reporter as she is led, by Holy Spirit, to break down Scripture into practical lessons for everyday life—without the confusion, religious jargon, or unnecessary theological complexity. Whether you're new to the Bible or a seasoned student of the Word, you'll discover timeless wisdom, encouragement, and truth you can apply today. Reporting the King's News, one Scripture at a time. Come hungry. Leave nourished. Return transformed.

title: The Attack the Paint Show with Ravneet Singh
author: Ravneet Singh
description: The Attack the Paint Show is a basketball podcast hosted by Ravneet Singh, focused on NBA team building, player evaluation, trades, the draft, and the strategy behind how successful teams are built. Through in-depth analysis and conversations with people around the game, the show goes beyond the headlines to explore the decisions that shape teams and players.

title: Duck! Duck! Hike!
author: Blake & Garrett
description: Two brothers talking all things football your way! The sports channel of @DuckTakes!

title: The Blackhawk and Gold Podcast
author: The Blackhawk and Gold Podcast
description: From Causeway to the Midway and everywhere in between! Blackhawk and Gold is a project of love of Andrew Johnson & Emily Pinson. Two superfans of two O6 teams trying to make sense of their team's place in NHL. Join them as they sort through their encyclopedic knowledge of their teams while coming to understand the rival on the other side. And have a lot of fun along the way. Go Hawks? Go Bruins? Why not both!

title: Off Autopilot: Now What?
author: Ilana Blum
description:
Not here because I figured it out. I'm still figuring it out, actually.
It's for high-achieving women, and anyone raised to be one, who did everything right and are still asking: is this it?
Every week I get into the brain science behind why we get stuck, coach through real questions from real listeners, and do the honest, messy work of figuring out what we actually want and then going after it.
I'm Ilana, a life coach and founder of 18th Healing. I'm not talking to you from the other side of a transformation. I'm in the middle of one. And I think that matters.
New episodes every week.

title: Crew Connect
author: Ces and Rod
description:
We talk about the systems, culture and realities of life at sea—through honest conversations, funny memories and unfiltered opinions!
After 7 years at sea, we both understand that life at sea, is a very unique "ecosystem" that is mostly talked about through memes, gossip and 15 second reels. And while all of those are necessary, and give crew members a sense of community and understanding, we wanted to try and actually have a longer conversation about the things we loved, the things we struggled with, and the things we hope to one day see improve for all crew onboard.

title: Highway Into Heaven
author: Ginger Arnold and Terry Thompson-Schmitz
description:
Welcome to Highway Into Heaven, a Catholic podcast created by students for students who want to grow deeper in their Faith. Each episode brings real talk on prayer life, inspiring interviews with priests and religious sharing their vocation stories, information on the Saints and how they lived out their Catholic Faith . Whether you're navigating high school, college, or just trying to keep Christ at the center of your life, this show offers encouragement, practical wisdom, and reminds you that you're not alone on this journey. 
Original theme music by Chris Zimmerman and The Saint Songs Band

title: Ho 2 Housewife
author: H2H
description: Hosted by Lauren Hyde and Caroline Wolf, H2H: Ho 2 Housewife is a candid lifestyle podcast where real conversations meet personal growth. From dating and relationships to motherhood, wellness, and self-discovery, every episode delivers honest stories, empowering insights, and the reminder that every woman's journey matters.

title: Scarface, The Valiant
author: LOUDBROWN AUDIO
description: Tragedy, bullying and low self esteem...that was Christy's life until she and a group of her friends decided to turn the tables on the bullies, but neither she nor her friends expected the chain of events that would follow. She just wanted them to leave her alone! Now her world had been turned completely upside down. How could she turn them right-side-up again? Or was that even possible? Hear how one teen overcame the issues of bullying and low self-esteem to find purpose and fulfillment when she encountered a world of fantasy that might be truer than life.

title: Drained Battery Society
author: Peter Conway
description:
Drained Battery Society podcast is for people who remember life before passwords, QR-code menus and being asked to download an app just to park the car. It's a field guide to modern adulthood for anyone who's accumulated a little wisdom, a few aches and pains, and plenty of opinions. 


Hosted by Peter Conway, each episode examines work, aging, technology, modern life and the thousand small indignities nobody warned us about—along with fake sponsors, questionable advice, Universal Truths, and the occasional recommendation that's actually useful.


Drained Battery Society. 

Barely charged. 

Fully opinionated.

title: The Western PA Work Injury Podcast
author: thewesternpaworkinjurypodcast
description: The Western PA Work Injury Podcast is dedicated to providing valuable information and insights for workers navigating the complexities of workplace injuries and compensation claims in Western Pennsylvania. Hosted by experienced professionals, the podcast covers a range of topics from legal rights and employer obligations to practical advice for protecting income and benefits. With a focus on clarity and actionable guidance, the series aims to empower listeners with the knowledge needed to make informed decisions in the wake of a work-related injury.

title: Nutritious Minds Podcast
author: Nutritious Minds Podcast
description: Nutritious Minds Podcast explores brain health, ADHD, neurodivergence, nutrition, and the complexity, fragility, and essence of human life. Hosted by Dr. Rachel V. Gow, each episode brings together leading researchers, expert clinicians, practitioners, and lived-experience voices to translate complex science into real-world conversations for families, adults, educators, and professionals. No sensationalist sound bites. No fluff. Real conversations.

title: The Nachos
author: The Nachos
description:
Hi Fam! 
Welcome to our podcast page. We are Karabo and Sindy, husband and wife who are passionate about seeing our marriage thrive. Journey with us as we navigate it through intentional conversations. Two imperfect yet willing, surrended vessels.

title: The Diaries of Mel: Growing in Real Time
author: Mella
description: This season is about healing, surrender, identity and choosing God daily even when it’s challenging and uncomfortable. It’s raw, reflective and real- time growth.

title: Stronger
author: Sustainable Living
description: Stronger is a podcast for anyone ready to tap into their inner strength, shift their mindset, and live with more purpose. Host Gabby B. explores themes like, self-belief, sustainability, emotional resilience, and personal growth, in an accessible way. Whether you’re just beginning your journey or deepening the one you are on, each episode is here to help you feel empowered, grounded, and ultimately... stronger.

title: Being untethered podcast
author: Miho Otani
description:
here we are creating a space for women who are ready to stop doubting themselves and start becoming the most confident, magnetic version of who they truly are (yes, you!) 
we explore self-love, manifestation, feminine energy, and the science of the subconscious mind

title: Everybody Sells!
author: Beth McClary-Wolford
description:
Business isn’t just about revenue.
It’s about relationships, leadership, visibility, trust, and the conversations that create growth.
Hosted by Beth McClary-Wolford, Everybody Sells features real stories, practical strategies, and straight talk from entrepreneurs, business owners, and leaders who are building something worth keeping.
Whether you’re growing a company, leading a team, serving clients, or building your reputation, you’ll discover why influence, communication, and relationships matter more than ever.
Because whether you realize it or not…
Everybody sells.

title: The Internet Culture Podcast
author: internet-culture
description: A podcast exploring the internet’s biggest stories, viral moments, online drama, social media trends, memes, AI, tech culture, and digital rabbit holes — breaking down what the internet is obsessed with right now and why it matters.

title: AI WORLD TV
author: AI World Journal
description:
AI World TV is a newly launched media channel focused on delivering news, interviews, and analysis about artificial intelligence and its impact on society, business, and technology.
It is part of the broader AI World ecosystem (101 AI World / AI World Media Group LLC) and is designed as a dedicated "AI journalism and insights" platform rather than traditional entertainment TV.

title: Two Therapists, One Couch
author: tammywagnertherapy
description:
Sit down and have a listen to two Saskatchewan Therapists talk about the profession, answer questions that clients frequently have and tackle topics surrounding mental health.

Real talk. Professional Perspectives. Human Connection.

Funny and educational, this podcast is not meant to be in place of therapy.

title: Truck Parking Club: Member Case Studies
author: Truck Parking Club
description:
The Member Case Study Podcast from Truck Parking Club. Each episode is one interview with a real member: property owners who list unused land, lots, and yards for truck parking, and the trucking companies that book those spaces. They walk through how they got started, what they list, what it's earned them, and what running it actually looks like day to day.

If you have space that sits empty or you run trucks and need places to park them, these are the people already doing it, in their own words.

title: Where The Art Lives
author: Tanya Mascarenhas
description: Hosted by artist, art historian and writer Tanya Mascarenhas, Where the Art Lives is a personal podcast where an array of fascinating stories from some of the art world’s most influential gallerists, collectors and curators come to life.

title: Tales with Matilda
author: Matilda Green
description: Hello! I'm Matilda, and I love stories. On this podcast I'll be reading some of our families' favourite stories. I hope you enjoy!

author: Cobblers Podcast

The very first Episode of That Cobblers Podcast!


The podcast that brings you views, transfers, rumours, match reviews and previews and talks all things Northampton Town FC.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: FPL Pubcast
author: Gary Britton
description: The home of the FPL Pubcast and FPL Lock-In podcasts, FPL preview and reaction podcasts hosted by the FPL Pubcast Landlord Gary! Gary is regularly joined by the FPL Pubcast regulars: Trigger, FPL D-Unit, FPL Nightmare, Roberto Hollis, Kanji FPL and FPL Punk as well as by a range of special guests. This is also home of the Meet The FPL Manager podcast.

title: Maverick School Podcast
author: maverickschoolpodcast
description:
School prepared us for exams.
But the world young people are entering today looks completely different.

Degrees don’t guarantee jobs anymore.
Career ladders are disappearing.
AI is reshaping industries faster than most schools can keep up.

And many young people — and their parents — feel it.

That’s where this podcast comes in.

The Maverick School Podcast is about the career education school forgot.

Hosted by an educator with 16+ years of frontline experience helping young people navigate careers, this show explores how the modern world of work actually works — and what young people need to succeed in it.

Each episode features honest conversations with entrepreneurs, leaders, and creatives who are building real careers in today’s economy.

If you’re:
• A young person trying to figure out your direction
• A graduate feeling stuck or behind
• A parent worried about your child’s future
• Or someone trying to understand the new economy

This podcast is for you.

Inside the show we explore:
• How careers really work in the 21st century
• Skills that matter in the new economy
• Networking, personal branding, and opportunity creation
• Money, mindset, and resilience
• How people are building careers outside traditional paths

No fluff.
No outdated advice.
Just real-world insight from people living it.

Because the future belongs to people who learn beyond the classroom.

Welcome to Maverick School.

title: Meeting Point Matters
author: Wayne Jenson
description:
Welcome to the Meeting Point Matters podcast. Brining you informal conversations with the people, charities and organisations creating positive change in our communities. From inspiring stories and practical insights to new projects and community initiatives, we explore the work happening behind the scenes and the impact it has on people's lives.
Join me as I talk with charity professionals and local leaders to share ideas, celebrate success, and discover what it takes to build stronger communities. At the heart of every episode is our commitment to Inspire, Connect and Enable.

title: Elevated Focus
author: Julia Xanthos Liddy
description:
Every woman has a story worth telling and when you're building something meaningful, the way you tell that story matters. 
Welcome to Elevated Focus, hosted by photographer and storyteller Julia Xanthos Liddy. Every Monday, Julia and inspiring guests share honest conversations to help you find clarity, build confidence and create a life and business that's uniquely yours. Because Julia's work has never just been about taking beautiful photographs, it's about helping women be seen. 
Follow and start your next chapter today.

title: Still Human: Real Talk in the Age of AI
author: Nadia Koski
description:
AI is rewriting how we work, how we build,  who benefits, and who gets left behind in the process. We've been told AI is the great equalizer. The data says otherwise.

Still Human: Real Talk in the Age of AI is the podcast that goes inside the rooms where the future is being built and asks the questions nobody's asking on stage and puts the raw conversations on record.

Host Nadia Koski is a marketing and brand strategist as well as podcast network producer, with over a decade in media, content innovation, and advertising technology. Every other week she sits down with the builders, leaders and thinkers navigating this moment: CEOs and startup founders, data scientists and creative directors, NGO leaders, engineers and entrepreneurs doing remarkable things across every time zone.

The conversations are candid, unscripted and go behind-the-scenes on what we're really doing with AI. Nadia gets under every guest's skin, the mental blocks, the habits, the stories they had to unlearn to get where they are today. The question underneath all of it: what does it actually take to stay human while the world rewrites itself around you?

title: The Grumpy Old Man Podcast
author: Kevin Stone
description:
Look, I'm just a bonehead who started a podcast before I was ready to start a podcast. So now, I have a podcast for a whole year without any viable substance to have a podcast about. I am constantly being called, or labeled, or suggested as a grumpy old man where I work.Truth be told it is because I work with a bunch of younger boneheads who haven't matured enough to realize they are boneheads yet, but I have hope in their abbilities to figure that out someday. 

So, I thought, what the heck. Here you go, "The Grumpy Old Man Podcast", hopefully over the course of the next year it will blossom into a world renown podcast and I will become a millionaire, or it will fade away after time and nothing will change. Let's roll the dice.  

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/the-grumpy-old-man-podcast--7213137/support.

title: fumbling together
author: chloe hoang-nguyen
description:
welcome to my cluttered corner - where i publicly search for meaning in life experiences that probably didn't need this much analysis.
what don't i think about without the urge to dissect the psychology behind it? nothing. i take apart adulthood like it's LEGO and somehow still don't have the answers.
i’m self-aware but lost. i'm opinionated but unsure. i'm also ADHD AF. i'm all things in between as i fumble through everything, and nothing at all. is this a mistake? maybe. but it's mine to make. if you're fumbling through life too, welcome in :")

title: Freedom Caucus Podcast
author: Patrick Parsons
description: The Freedom Caucus Podcast, hosted by Patrick Parsons, brings you unfiltered conversations with members of the House Freedom Caucus and other influential voices shaping the future of America. Each episode goes beyond the headlines to explore the biggest battles in Congress, the fight for limited government, constitutional principles, border security, fiscal responsibility, and the issues driving the conservative movement. Whether it's exclusive interviews with lawmakers or engaging discussions with policy experts, candidates, and grassroots leaders, the Freedom Caucus Podcast delivers the insights and behind-the-scenes perspective you won't find anywhere else.

title: The Human Bits
author: Deborah McPhilemy
description: The Human Bits is a podcast about understanding yourself instead of fixing yourself. Through honest, grounded conversations, we explore emotions, trauma, relationships, nervous system healing, self-worth, and the patterns that shape how we think, feel, and behave. It’s a space to make sense of your inner world, reconnect with who you are beneath the noise, and gently unravel the belief that you need to be someone else to feel okay. Together, we focus on creating a life that feels authentic, peaceful, and truly yours.

title: Fractions
author: kavi
description:
What if one label was never enough to define a person?
Movies, storytelling, psychology, fitness, fashion — these aren’t random topics. They’re things I genuinely connect with.
But most people end up being known for just one thing. A role, a label — even though it’s only a part of who they are.
Fractions comes from that idea. This is where I share different parts of myself through the things I care about.
Built as an audio experience you can listen to anytime.
Not one label. Just different fractions of the same person.

title: WOW: Wise Older Women
author: Rasela Torise
description:
“Wisdom that grows louder with time.”


Welcome to WOW: Wise Older Women a podcast dedicated to raising the status of ageing women and dismantling the narratives that silence them.


Here, older women speak with authority, beauty, depth, and fire. Their stories challenge, inspire, and illuminate.


In a world that too often ignores, isolates, or diminishes older women, we choose to listen. To revere and celebrate the brilliance, courage, humour and tenderness they bring along with plenty of high‑vibration wisdom carried in their words.


These conversations aren’t just stories, each one of them is a teaching. A personal map from the past, forging the way ahead, full of magic, medicine and momentum.


This storytelling series presents ageing not as decline, but as ascent. It’s a platform where older women don’t need to hide. This is where they are honoured, uplifted, heard and held; with reverence, respect, and wonder.


Their voices are powerful, their wisdom is vibrant, and their stories are a gift to us all.


Welcome to the podcast. Settle in. Let their voices guide you.

title: Treading Water
author: SWIM Cooperative
description: Treading Water is a podcast by SWIM, S*x Workers in Minnesota. We discuss community, coalition with other s*x workers, education by and for s*x workers, as well as educating those who have never been in the adult industry. We have a local focus on Minnesota, and state and city policies that affect us, however we also talk about worldwide approaches to s*x work, media portrayal of s*x workers and the adult industry, and much more. We highlight SWIM Cooperative's current events and community cultivation while fighting for our rights and safety as well as using this platform as an oral history of our shared experiences.

title: Healing the Soul Devotional Podcast
author: Joyce Meyer
description: A healthy, well-functioning soul is available for every human. No matter what kind of hurt and pain you've been through, you can find hope and healing in God's Word! Through her Healing the Soul Devotional Podcast, Joyce Meyer shares 50 days of devotions that will inspire you to let go of the past and put your trust in God for a new beginning and a brighter future. Whatever the wound, Christ holds the healing.

Lights, Camera, Yaption is like receiving an hour long voice note from your friend who is running late to work and wants to "quickly" tell you their latest take on something you watched when you were 12. Join Samp as he deep dives into TV, Film, TikTok, Pop Culture, that one reality TV show from 2006 he just can't believe hasn't been revived, and more!
Will there be guests? Maybe! Will there be hot nuanced takes about media? Maybe! Will there be laughter? God he hopes so.

author: Chase Your Extraordinary
description: The Chase Your Extraordinary Podcast is for ordinary people curious about what they might be capable of. Through honest conversations, lived adventures and the messy middle, we explore movement, mindset, setbacks and the small choices that build confidence. No empty motivational slogans—just real stories, practical lessons and an invitation to ask: “I wonder if I can…?” You don’t need to run across a country. Walking counts. Five minutes counts. Starting again counts. Wherever you’re starting, you’re welcome here.

title: Dead Format
author: The staff of the Dead Storage VHS Rental Shop in Gateshead
description:
Synopsis
A haunted VHS rental shop that never closed, tucked away in your neighbourhood, is the only place left to escape to for a duvet day of favourite films—where the internet is down, and the films might just have a life of their own.
Each episode, your hosts (the shop’s employees) chat about films in a freewheeling, nostalgic, and slightly surreal way. Sometimes, a strange VHS turns up. Sometimes, the shop’s mysterious owner leaves cryptic instructions. And sometimes, a film might not end the way you remember it…

description: On This Still Hits, join Jean, Danielle, and Kim to discuss (almost) all the pop culture that we experienced as kids, pre-teens, teens, and even 20-somethings. We’ll jump from movies to music, TV to MySpace. If you’re down to listen to elder millennials as we wax nostalgic, this is for you!

title: How to Start a Business for Free
author: Derron Amrein
description:
How to Start a Business for Free is a build-in-public podcast documenting the real journey of creating businesses from the ground up using AI, free tools, and relentless problem solving.
Each episode follows entrepreneur Derron Amrein as he turns ideas into real companies—sharing the wins, mistakes, pivots, and lessons learned along the way. Instead of talking about entrepreneurship in theory, this podcast shows what it actually looks like to validate ideas, build MVPs, attract customers, develop products, pitch businesses, leverage artificial intelligence, and launch startups with little capital.
Whether you’re interested in entrepreneurship, startups, SaaS, AI, product development, small business, no-code tools, marketing, sales, customer validation, or building a business while working a full-time job, you’ll get practical insights you can apply immediately.
Current episodes follow the development of Stride Guide, an AI-powered retail platform designed to help independent retailers increase customer traffic, improve retention, train employees, and create more predictable recurring revenue.
If you’re looking for honest founder stories instead of overnight success, subscribe and build alongside us.
New episodes every week.

From starting your first investment to mastering advanced strategies, this podcast is your guide to success. Get an exclusive glimpse into the life of Mike Leblanc as he navigates between the dynamic real estate industry, maintaining a healthy household, and most importantly, enjoying life along the way.

Welcome to the Long Distance Girlfriends podcast, hosted by two best friends across an ocean and an 11-12 hour time difference, with Julie in Vietnam and Christine in the US.

From entrepreneurship and marketing to motherhood, personal growth, productivity, wellness, and faith, Michelle shares honest stories, practical strategies, and thoughtful conversations to help you stay focused on what matters most.

Whether you're growing a business, raising a family, pursuing creative work, or seeking a more intentional life, you'll find encouragement and wisdom for building a life, vocation, and legacy that lasts.

description:
SoulSpeak: Where Purpose Meets Presence

SoulSpeak is a podcast for people seeking healing, alignment, and authentic leadership in both life and career.

Hosted by Donna Karaba, a former Fortune 500 executive who chose a more deeply aligned path rooted in purpose and authenticity, SoulSpeak explores what happens when we stop following external paradigms and start trusting the inner voice guiding us toward something more.

This show is for:

• Individuals navigating chronic pain or searching for alternative approaches to healing and holistic wellness
 • Professionals feeling stuck, burned out, or misaligned in their careers
 • Women balancing ambition, leadership, and personal fulfillment
 • Aspiring entrepreneurs and career pivoters ready to follow their passion
 • Leaders seeking authentic, purpose-driven leadership
 • Anyone who feels the quiet unrest of living out of alignment

Through conversations with clinicians, founders, innovators, thought leaders, and courageous pivoters, SoulSpeak explores:

• Integrative and holistic perspectives on health and well-being
 • Healing beyond conventional systems
 • Career transitions and reinvention
 • Leadership development rooted in integrity
 • Personal growth and self-trust
 • Building a life aligned with passion and purpose

If you’ve ever felt like your soul was shrinking inside a life that looked successful on paper… this podcast is for you.

Because healing isn’t just physical.
 And success isn’t just external.

Alignment changes everything.

The Human AI Mindset explores how people can use artificial intelligence without surrendering judgment, authorship, creativity, or meaning. Each episode turns one urgent idea into a practical conversation about leadership, education, work, and what it means to remain fully human in an age of intelligent tools.
Hosted by Dr. Cory Scott, the show is for people who want more than AI tips. It is for those who want to think better, lead wisely, protect what matters, and use AI to expand human possibility rather than replace it.

title: SIGNAL: Grounded in Truth
author: Michael Vincent
description:
Everyone in this industry has a podcast now. Give it a year, the freight brokers will too.

So yes, we know the irony. We're launching a show into an industry with more voices than listeners, more hot takes than actual takes, more people explaining freight on camera than people who've dispatched a truck. Noise isn't what we're short on. It's what we're drowning in.

Here's the difference. SIGNAL: Grounded in Truth is long-format, on purpose. Truth doesn't fit in ninety seconds. A ninety-second clip is somebody's opinion wearing a blazer. A real conversation, given room to breathe, stops performing and starts being honest — worth thirty minutes of your day, and none of your scrolling.

In 1 Kings 19:11-12, Elijah stood on the mountain expecting God in the wind, the earthquake, the fire — and found Him instead in the still small voice that came after. Most of what passes for insight here is wind, earthquake, and fire. We built this show for the quiet after. That's where the signal lives.

Industry leaders. Operators. People who've lived with their own decisions. No fluff, no scripts, no one performing for an algorithm.

Available on all major podcast platforms. Follow 146 Media — 146-Media on LinkedIn, @146Media1 on X, 146media on Instagram, @146Media-Spartan on YouTube.

The industry doesn't need another voice. It needs somewhere quiet enough to hear the ones already worth hearing.

Peace and Love.

title: The Charter Desk
author: Limitless Sky
description:
What really happens when you book a private jet?

In the first episode of The Charter Desk, Alice speaks with Marcus Whitfield, Senior Booking Agent at Limitless Sky, about the people who charter private aircraft, the reasons they fly privately and the complicated work that happens behind every apparently effortless departure.

From missing landing slots and overloaded baggage compartments to Monaco Grand Prix congestion, Davos winter operations and unusual passenger requests, Marcus explains why booking a private jet involves considerably more than choosing a luxurious cabin.

And no, a Gulfstream is not an Uber.

description: Every crime scene leaves behind more than evidence—it leaves unanswered questions. Shadows of Truth: True Crime Files explores mysterious disappearances, shocking murders, unsolved investigations, criminal psychology, forensic breakthroughs, and the hidden stories behind infamous cases from around the world. Each episode presents a carefully researched narrative that focuses on facts, investigative methods, and the human impact of crime. Whether you're fascinated by cold cases, serial investigations, or modern forensic science, this podcast delivers gripping true crime stories while respecting victims and avoiding sensationalism.

title: Tyrella Off the Record
author: Tyrella off the Record
description:
True crime news, trial coverage, courtroom updates, and breaking case developments—without the noise.
Tyrella Off the Record brings you timely updates on the cases you care about most, from courtroom testimony and new filings to breaking developments and the context behind the headlines.
I'm Tyrella, a true crime host since 2017, formerly of Killer Queens which is now This Feels Criminal. Here, I follow cases as they unfold and break down what happened, why it matters, and what you need to know next—without requiring you to spend all day watching court or refreshing social media.
Some episodes are quick updates. Others go deeper when a story needs more context. During major trials, you'll find regular coverage of testimony, witnesses, rulings, and the moments that could shape the case.
For deeper long-form investigations and analysis, listen to This Feels Criminal.
And if you want everything I'm following delivered in one place each week, join The Record Briefing, my free weekly email: https://rebrand.ly/offrecord

From random thoughts and funny stories to life, friendship, trends, and all the unexpected tangents in between, no topic is off limits. title: Stark's Notch
author: Gus Pike
description:
Two brothers, one small town in the New Hampshire mountains, and a light burning in a fire tower nobody's climbed in fifty years.

Stark's Notch is a serialized adventure for boys 8–12 — and for the parents driving them somewhere. Beaver dams and blackfly bounties, jackknife trades and toll bridges, real woods and real weather, and a dad who spends about forty words a day and means every one of them.

Told by Gus Pike, who was there, and who is still not entirely over it.

First four episodes free. New episodes weekly.

EAT IT OR BURY IT.

On this channel, I offer weekly episodes about various aspects of history, including biographies, military campaigns, battles, and events that shaped the world, as well as the lives and deeds of prominent historical figures. Listen to this podcast to explore ancient civilizations such as Egypt, Rome, Persia, Greece, China, and many others. All the materials offered here are elaborated in detail to ensure a clear understanding of the topic at hand.

Abby Histories podcast aims to provide history, biography, and society-related content that is interesting to both history lovers and students who wish to improve their knowledge of the past and gain insight into present-day affairs. So, if you want to learn more about your ancestors and their way of life, as well as some lesser-known facts about famous people, follow this channel and discover history one interesting episode at a time!

title: Magnetic Barbering Podcast
author: Roger Bickley
description:
Magnetic Barbering Podcast The Magnetic Barbering Podcast documents Rog tha Barber’s journey to build 250 Magnetic Barbering locations across America.

This is bigger than opening barbershops. It’s about building a barbering system that creates:
  • Affordable, quality haircuts for clients
  • Strong income and real opportunity for barbers
  • Safe, clean spaces for children and families
  • Comfortable environments where mothers feel respected
  • Community-centered shops where people can connect
  • A business model built to last for generations
You’ll hear the real journey—the plans, decisions, mistakes, wins, setbacks, numbers, marketing, hiring, leadership, expansion, and everything it takes to turn one vision into a national barbering brand. No fake success story after everything is already finished.

You’re watching it get built in real time. The mission is simple: Help barbers earn more.

Help clients get great cuts at fair prices.

Build safe shops that communities trust.

Create a system that survives for generations. This is not just a barber podcast.

 This is the story of building the future of barbering. Welcome to Magnetic Barbering.

title: When People Lead
author: Jeffrey Rola
description:
When People Lead (taken from the Gandhi quote, "When the people lead, the leaders follow.") is a simple premise in three parts. First we celebrate people who strive to make the world a little bit better each day. We host conversations with leaders in science, culture, justice and environment. Most are not well known, working on obscure projects in remote communities. But some can be found right in your neighborhood. 
Next, we use the podcast medium itself. From our micro-studio on the south coast of Oregon we can speak to the world -- and the world can speak to us. We will use our mics and cameras to connect what anthropologist Margaret Meade called, "those small groups of committed citizens," that change the world. 
Third, we end each episode with the call to action, "Find the leader within." We hope to build a network of leaders sharing ideas, perspectives and insights, all in service to the common good. right now this seems like a tall order. We believe that there is no problem too great to overcome When People Lead.

title: Building Your Career Blueprint

Most graduates earn a degree. Far fewer graduate with a career strategy. Building Your Career Blueprint is a weekly show about closing that gap.
Hosted by Chris Dotson and Tom Borg, co-founders of Career Blueprint Co., each episode breaks down what's really happening in the job market, what employers actually want, and the mindset, skills, and habits that get you hired and keep you advancing. Welcome to Red Fence is where politics gets pulled apart—no talking points, no filters, no blind loyalty. Each episode dives into the stories shaping America and the world, cutting through media spin, government narratives, and the noise to ask the questions most people won’t.
From controversial headlines to underreported angles, Redfence challenges the official version and explores what’s really going on beneath the surface. Whether it’s policy, power, or hidden agendas, nothing is off-limits.
If you’re tired of being told what to think and want a sharper, more independent perspective, come on in.

title: Making Sense with Madi the SLP
author: Madi Metcalf, MS, CCC-SLP
description:
Join Madi Metcalf, MS, CCC-SLP, as she helps speech-language pathologists bridge the gap between research and clinical practice. Each season focuses on a different area of speech-language pathology, featuring conversations with leading researchers and expert clinicians who discuss the latest evidence, its clinical implications, and practical strategies you can apply with confidence. From pediatric feeding and myofunctional therapy to future topics across the profession, you'll gain evidence-based insights to strengthen your clinical skills and provide high-quality, evidence-based care.
Each episode is eligible for 0.10 ASHA CEUs when you complete the accompanying course through Speech Therapy PD.

author: Christina Belue + Oriana Padron
description: Welcome to Rio & Soul - a sacred space for mothers reconnecting with themselves while creating lives that feel aligned, meaningful, and deeply their own. Hosted by Christina Belue, mom of two and Certified Somatic Breathwork and Bodywork Practitioner, and Oriana Padron, mom of three, Photographer and Creative Strategist, Rio & Soul is rooted in a shared passion to create a space where mothers feel heard, seen, supported, and inspired to trust themselves more deeply. Each episode offers practical insight, education, and grounded strategies that support real-life transformation.

title: Professional Wrestling Secrets Podcast: Wrestling Exposed—Kayfabe, Blading, Backstage Politics, Match Tricks, and the Hidden Business of Pro Wrestling
author: Podily
description:
Professional Wrestling Secrets Podcast: Wrestling Exposed—Kayfabe, Blading, Backstage Politics, Match Tricks, and the Hidden Business of Pro Wrestling pulls back the curtain on how professional wrestling really works. Each episode explores the secrets behind scripted rivalries, predetermined finishes, match psychology, blade jobs, referee signals, worked injuries, crowd manipulation, promos, character development, protected moves, and the techniques wrestlers use to make the action feel real.

The podcast also examines backstage politics, booking decisions, championships, jobbers, locker-room culture, contracts, promoters, creative control, and the business strategies that shape wrestling behind the scenes. Whether you are a lifelong fan or newly curious about what happens beyond the ring, this show reveals the hidden methods, traditions, and realities of professional wrestling.

title: No Time But Now with William Shatner and Melanie Shatner Gretsch
author: Melis Productions Inc
description: No Time But Now with William Shatner and Melanie Shatner Gretsch is a weekly video podcast inspired by their shared experience as father and daughter battling—and surviving—Stage 4 cancers. Their journey became the starting point for a deeper exploration of health, longevity, and resilience in pursuit of living well. Each week, William and Melanie engage with researchers advancing the science of longevity, wellness practitioners, spiritual and religious leaders, fellow survivors, physicians who helped guide their own cancer journeys, and extraordinary individuals and friends whose experiences offer wisdom, resilience, and hope. Blending these insights with humor, warmth, and deeply personal storytelling, the series invites audiences to discover new perspectives, live with intention, and make every moment count.

title: Gender Crisis
author: Flynn Mason & Riss Bolen
description:
By trans nerds, for trans nerds, Gender Crisis sits at the intersection of media, sociology, and the trans experience. Together, we take a curious, vulnerable, and friendship-based approach to exploring the question, "What does it mean to be trans in today's world?"


Hosted by RTA alum Flynn Mason (he/him) and student of sociology Riss Bolen (they/them), this unique chatcast offers a welcoming window into the genuine energy of organic trans friendship; blending tangents, community participation, and the occasional gender crisis to collaboratively unpack the questions that plague the gender diverse community each and every episode.


Part non-fiction storytelling, part social science, and part media analysis, Gender Crisis builds a space for trans listeners seeking trans community, and for anyone curious enough to question what they thought they knew.

title: The Relative Truth
author: Ashley
description:
The Relative Truth 

Welcome to The Relative Truth, where two cousins, lifelong best friends, and unfiltered storytellers dive into the conversations everyone else is thinking but rarely says out loud. From hilarious family memories and everyday chaos to relationships, parenting, hot takes, and real-life struggles, nothing is off the table. With plenty of laughs, honest opinions, and the kind of chemistry only family can have, every episode feels like sitting around the kitchen table with your favorite relatives. You may not always agree with us—but you’ll always get The Relative Truth.

title: Morning Paranoia | English
author: Our House
description:
Morning Paranoia is the weekly podcast by Our House, hosted by Olga Karach. The content, research and original voice are created by Olga Karach; the English version is produced using AI voice technology provided by our partner ElevenLabs.
Each week we analyze democracy, human rights, war, authoritarian trends and disinformation. Through facts, context and a touch of irony, Morning Paranoia helps make sense of current events and their consequences. After all, just because you're paranoid doesn't mean no one is watching you.

title: Women in Finance: The CISI
author: The CISI
description:
Women in Finance is a new podcast from the CISI, shining a light on the experiences, insights and achievements of women across the financial services sector. Hosted by Paula Murphy of the Corporate Finance and Capital Markets Forum, each episode features candid conversations with accomplished professionals who have built successful careers in finance.


From corporate finance and capital markets to leadership, innovation and beyond, guests share their journeys, challenges and lessons learned along the way. The series explores not only what it takes to succeed, but also how the industry is evolving—and the role women are playing in shaping its future.


Whether you’re starting out, looking to progress, or simply interested in hearing from inspiring voices in finance, Women in Finance offers thoughtful perspectives, practical insights and honest discussion from those who know the sector best.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Craig & Chels
author: Power FM & iHeart Australia
description:
Wake up with Craig and Chels weekdays from 6, the breakfast show proudly local and bringing big smiles across the Murraylands, Hills and South Coast.
Craig is a quirky, fun, dad of four, and proudly obsessed with Pokémon, so you never quite know how the chat will evolve (that’s a Pokémon joke apparently).
Chels is creative, quick-witted, and a massive Ed Sheeran fan, who adds heart and humour to every conversation.
Together they love making you feel good, laugh often, and start each day smiling.
It’s local, lively, welcoming radio made by people who genuinely care about this community.

title: Dialogue Hour Podcast
author: Melissa
description:
Welcome to Dialogue Hour—where every conversation is an opportunity to discover purpose, build stronger connections, and grow into the best version of ourselves.


In a world that often moves too fast to truly listen, this is a space to pause, reflect, and engage in conversations that matter. Here, we believe that every voice has value, every story holds wisdom, and every shared experience has the power to inspire change.

Growth isn’t a destination—it’s a journey we take together. Through honest dialogue, thoughtful questions, and open hearts, we’ll explore the ideas that challenge us, encourage us, and remind us that none of us are meant to walk this path alone.

Whether you’re seeking motivation, fresh perspectives, or simply a reminder that hope is always within reach, you’ve found a community that believes in the power of conversation to transform lives.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. Open your mind. Open your heart. And together, let’s spark meaningful dialogue, ignite lasting change, and embrace the desire to grow together.

This is Dialogue Hour—where conversations inspire, connections deepen, and growth begins.

Let’s grow together.

title: Naga Subramanian's Podcast
author: Naga Subramanian
description:
A fusion of “café” and “dialogue,” Caffelogue is where meaningful conversations brew.
I’m Naga — a vegan, wellness advocate, fitness enthusiast, and customer success leader with a passion for purposeful living.

Over the past two decades, I’ve built meaningful professional relationships and collaborated with inspiring leaders across diverse industries. Through my podcast, Caffelogue with Naga, I host industry experts and bestselling authors in wellness, veganism, leadership, and finance to share their insights—empowering listeners to cultivate strong habits and embrace lifelong learning.

title: Faith In The Line Of Duty
author: Daniel Johnson
description:
Life on the front lines is anything but easy. Whether you're serving in the military, working as a first responder, or supporting someone who is, the pressures, sacrifices, and unseen battles can weigh heavily. Faith in the Line of Duty is a podcast devoted to shining light in those dark places—through stories of hope, resilience, and transformation in Jesus Christ.
Hosted by U.S. Air Force servicemember Daniel Johnson, this show brings together voices from across the military and first responder communities. Each episode features personal testimonies, practical wisdom, and powerful conversations that highlight how a strong foundation of faith in Christ can carry us through the most challenging moments.
Our mission is simple:
1. Share the Gospel
2. Glorify God
3. Strengthen your walk with Christ
Whether you're in uniform, behind the scenes, or simply searching for encouragement, you're not alone—and you're always welcome here.
The views expressed are my own and do not constitute endorsement by the Department of Defense, Department of the Air Force, or the U.S. Government. My participation and appearance in any private or public events, sponsored or otherwise, or references, including external hyperlinks, to non-federal entities do not constitute or imply Department of Defense, Department of the Air Force or U.S. Government endorsement of any company or organization.

title: Building LA
author: Ben W
description: A podcast about the buildings and projects shaping Los Angeles, featuring the key individuals driving them forward. Each episode of Building LA features a leading figure in the Los Angeles design, real estate and business sectors. We engage in discussion about the pivotal choices that propelled their professional journey, the driving forces that sustain their motivation, and the untold narratives underlying their most remarkable projects. Subscribe to be inspired by leaders within the real estate industry, learn about the projects impacting Los Angeles, and listen to the insider perspectives on how these projects came to be.

title: Thirty Flirty Faithful
author: Thirty Flirty Faithful
description:
Welcome to Thirty Flirty Faithful, a podcast for women seeking to grow closer to God, discover their purpose, and embrace biblical femininity. Through honest conversations, faith filled encouragement, and real life experiences, we explore relationships, identity, motherhood, wellness, and what it means to live as the woman God created you to be. Whether you’re new to faith or have walked with Jesus for years, you’re welcome here.
Follow us:
Instagram: @thirtyflirtyfaithful
YouTube: @ThirtyFlirtyFaithful

title: LUXURIES FOR THE HOME
author: LUXURIES FOR THE HOME
description:
A home is more than walls, windows, doors, and a roof overhead. It is where our memories begin, where we seek comfort,
and where we learn about beauty in an otherwise chaotic world. Attuning to the seen and unseen energy within us — in our belongings and our environments — is a lifelong study. We open the door as you cross the threshold, grounded in awareness, guided by purpose, and open to possibility. Follow along for weekly episodes about Intentional Interior Design, Feng Shui, Space Clearing and more.

title: The Gold Hour Wine Company
author: David West
description:
Golden Hour is the behind-the-scenes journal of building a premium flavored wine brand from the ground up — a drink made for everyone.

Join founder David as he navigates supplier sourcing, formulation decisions, compliance hurdles, and brand-building — real conversations, real setbacks, real progress.

If you've ever wondered what it actually takes to launch a beverage brand people genuinely love, this is an unfiltered look at the process, one episode at a time.

Golden Hour Wine Company is a direct-to-consumer flavored wine brand made for everyone.

Follow along as we build a premium canned wine brand from scratch: sourcing, formulation, branding, and everything in between. One taste and you'll understand why — six flavors, one mission, for anyone who loves a good pour.

title: The Motherhood Network

title: COMMON GRAVITY
author: EDUARDO
description: Every life has breakups. Not just relationships. You can break up with a job. A business. A friend. A dream. A version of yourself. Hell… sometimes your favorite coffee shop closes and somehow that one hurts more than your last situationship. At least the coffee showed up every morning. This exists because life has a weird way of blowing things up right when you think you’ve finally figured it out. I’ve been through divorces, failed businesses, friendships that disappeared, relationships that wrecked me, wins that didn’t feel like wins, and moments where I genuinely had no clue what the hell came next. So this isn’t me pretending to have life all figured out. It’s me figuring it out with you. We’ll steal wisdom from psychologists, entrepreneurs, athletes, musicians, and the occasional lunatic who accidentally says something brilliant. We’ll laugh at ourselves because, honestly, if you can’t laugh at your own train wreck every now and then, you’re missing half the fun. No fake motivation. No “rise and grind.” No pretending everything happens for a reason while your life’s on fire. Just honest conversation, like it, hate it, I'm doing this for me. Some weeks about business. Some weeks about purpose. Some weeks I’ll probably just tell you about something incredibly stupid I did and what it taught me. The goal isn’t to become perfect. It’s to become a little better than yesterday. So if you’re rebuilding something… Welcome. Let’s get to work. We all have the same thing in Common and its Gravity.

Each episode explores the medical examiner's findings, autopsy reports, toxicology results, pathology, and investigative evidence that helped uncover the truth. At The Medical Examiner's Report, we believe every case represents a real person—not just a headline. Every episode is presented with compassion, professionalism, and respect for victims, their families, and the communities affected by these tragedies.

As a domestic violence survivor, a veteran advocate for family crisis support, and a national political leader, Lisa understands that real change happens when we look beyond the noise.
The Sweet Spot is the intersection where the unwavering truth of God’s justice meets the transformative power of His grace. Guided by the timeless wisdom of Micah 6:8, Lisa explores the issues shaping our nation through the lens of what God requires of us: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with Him.
From the halls of power to the kitchen table, this is a conversation that bridges the gap between the pews and the parliament. It is a space for those who want to move past the rhetoric and engage in a dialogue that is grounded in hard-won experience, fueled by a genuine love for God, and driven by a deep, active love for our neighbors.
Whether you are navigating the complexities of the justice system, seeking solutions for family safety, or looking for a more thoughtful way to engage with the news, Lisa invites you to focus on what truly matters. It is time to make the best of our history by living out the greatest commandments.
The Sweet Spot.
Justice, mercy, humility courage.

Serving the needs of humankind.

author: Susan Daniels
description:
SERIES PREMIERES AUGUST 13

If I've learned one thing from a career in healthcare, it's that colleagues train hard, show up, do the work, and quietly burn out. I saw it happen to others, but I didn't really understand the struggle until it happened to me.

I'm Dr. Sue Daniels, a pediatrician and survivor of what happens when a healthcare professional blinks and finds herself lost in a career she once loved. I'm also proud to say I found my way back, and if I can do it, so can you.

Every other week, I invite you to join me on Still Practicing as we explore what happens AFTER burnout prevention has run its course and you're left wondering what's next. Spoiler alert: it's not about coping better. It's about realistically answering one essential question:

What kind of life and career are actually worth coming back to?

I am DBT and Personality Disorder Certified, and I serve as an EMDR Consultant, supervisor, and AAMFT Supervisor. My practice is based in Columbus, Ohio, where I see clients both in person and online across the state. I believe in using what works best for you as an individual, rather than trying to fit you into a box of my making.
My goal with this podcast is to explain various therapy topics, demystify and destigmatize therapy as a whole. And even let you know if it's something you don't need.

description: State and local tax jurisdictions continue to evolve their tax systems around the US. Analyzing the latest key decisions, legislative and regulatory changes, and revenue agency guidance, the Eversheds Sutherland SALT Team focuses on providing tax professionals with a quick update of the most important developments in US state and local tax. The SALT Shaker Podcast helps tax professionals navigate growing challenges in the evolving tax systems of state and local jurisdictions.

title: Plants of the World
author: Plants of the World
description: God has made many amazing plants, and we will explore some of these plants together on this podcasts.

title: Ambassadors for Christ
author: David Wood
description:
Study the Word. Share the Story. Be the Ambassador.
What does it look like to live as if God is making His appeal through you? Ambassadors For Christ is a podcast dedicated to that exact question. Grounded in 2 Corinthians 5:20, we explore the dual role of the believer: to know the Word deeply and to share it authentically. Each episode features practical Bible study to ground your faith, followed by powerful testimonies of transformation.
Whether you are new to the faith or a seasoned believer, tune in to hear the stories and Scriptures that remind us we are the messengers of a love that changes everything.

title: Absolutely Unqualified
author: Erika and Sam
description: This is the podcast for the people who rehearse arguments in the shower, laugh at the worst possible moments, and have at least one memory that still keeps them awake at 2 a.m. We're saying the things everyone thinks but hopes someone else says first. So... hear us out first.

title: RE(ad)VIEWS
author: Iz and Drew
description: We share your Reviews of everything and anything including the weird and funny

title: The MNL show
author: The MNL Show
description:
In a moment of rapid technological change, economic uncertainty, and shifting workforce demands, leaders across Canada are being asked to navigate complexity with limited space for reflection. Decisions about talent, technology, productivity, and inclusion are increasingly interconnected, yet too often discussed in silos.

The MNL Show, hosted by Emily Madden, was created to change that.

The MNL Show is a new interview show designed to slow the conversation down and elevate it. Each episode brings together influential thinkers from business, government, education, and innovation to explore the forces reshaping our economy and what it will take for Canada to adapt with confidence.

More than a talk show, The MNL Show is a national conversation platform. It connects ideas across sectors, translates emerging signals into practical insight, and surfaces the leadership choices that will define our future of work. With Emily Madden’s thoughtful and incisive hosting, The MNL Show creates space for the conversations Canada needs — not just about what is changing, but how we respond.

title: Cooked In The Comments
author: Cooked In The Comments
description: A weekly show hosted by comedians Shapel Lacey & Cole Garrett featuring the internet's most viral videos and insane comments!

title: In The Comments
author: Mamamia Podcasts
description: The only thing funnier than your FYP? The comment section. Join Liv James and Olivia Colman on In The Comments as they giggle their way through everything unhinged on the internet right now. It's a weekly debrief for the chronically online girls, gays and theys, because we're in the comments with you... and we NEED to talk about it.

title: Between Two Worlds
author: Between Two Worlds
description:
Between Two Worlds is a media project exploring purpose, discipline, identity, and what it means to build a meaningful life in the modern world.
Through reflections, conversations, and commentary, we examine the challenges facing today’s generation: personal growth, entrepreneurship, culture, relationships, faith, ambition, and the pursuit of something deeper than success alone.
Drawing inspiration from both Eastern and Western perspectives, Between Two Worlds exists for those navigating life between cultures, expectations, traditions, and futures.
New episodes released regularly.

title: The Time-Saving Teacher Podcast - From Scattered to Strategic
author: Alison Howd - That Tech Savvy Teacher
description: There has to be a quicker way, right? The Time-Saving Teacher gives classroom teachers one practical system, tool, or strategy every Tuesday. Ten minutes. Real solutions. No overwhelm. Hosted by Alison Howd.

title: Getting Clinical
author: Ratnaja Katneni MD
description: Getting Clinical explores topics in medicine, aging and wellness through the lens of physiology and systems based clinical medicine. Hosted by Dr. Ratnaja Katneni , ABIM board certified internal medicine and nephrology physician with 25 years of clinical experience. This podcast explores how interconnected body systems influence health, and through medical literature and clinical observations, we learn how to optimize physiology, evaluate biomarkers, supplements, medications, treatments, known and evolving medical trends from wellness to illness with kidney as the central organ in aging.

title: The KnowThing Show
author: theknowthingshow
description: The KnowThing Show is your all-access pass to a broad spectrum of the unexplained, the highly debated, and the hilariously relatable. Hosted by LB alongside co-hosts "Bearded Bob" and "Chops," this dynamic trio cuts through the noise to deliver a compelling mix of speculative ideas, deep-dive investigative topics, and complex global dilemmas. But it’s not all heavy research; the guys aren't afraid to shift gears and air out those everyday frustrations we all deal with. Whether you're here to question everything or just to hear them call it like it is, The KnowThing Show has something for every curious mind.

title: Part-Time Pineapples
author: Part-Time Pineapples
description: Part-Time Pineapples follows a married couple as they take their first steps into the swinging lifestyle. We share honest conversations about trust, communication, boundaries, jealousy, excitement, awkward moments, and everything we learn along the way. This podcast is real, respectful, and judgment-free—a look at how one couple explores something new while keeping their marriage, friendship, and connection at the center of it all.
